What it does

Tidio puts a chat widget on your website that answers routine questions and captures contact details when you are unavailable. The free tier is usable, which makes it a low-risk way to stop losing visitors who will not pick up the phone. The AI needs some tuning, or it will confidently answer questions it should not.

Where the AI actually is

AI chatbot answers routine questions and captures contact details.

Pros

  • Free tier is genuinely usable
  • Easy to install on most site builders
  • Captures leads outside business hours

Cons

  • AI answers need tuning or they will guess wrong

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Landscapers in mind. Businesses with a website that gets visitors who never call.
